Today I had an appointment with the clinical nurse (I think that's hes title).  All I can say about him is OUTSTANDING.  Due to ongoing issues I've seen many consultants, doctors and nurses resulting in painkillers, exercises etc.  this is the first time that someone has actually looked at the possible underlying cause.

Really really happy that we are now making progress after 26 years of pain and discomfort.

The old one (2022 ish)

Decided to edit my review. Both my partner and I have had great service over the last 6 years for minor ailments. So why 5 to 1 star?

Recently my partner had some scans  pertaining to a chronic condition. Although inconclusive they did show an unrelated (probably) issues with another organ. Oblivious to the findings my partner was informed that the Dr would phone the following morning to discuss the results. As it was a phone call we were confident the issue would be minor.

What transpired is that my partner was phoned, at work, by the Practice Nurse to inform her that potentially (and I pray not) she may have one of the most aggressive forms of cancers.  Obviously stunned, and on her own, that she was unable to ask questions, nor was advice offered. She's now in bits. Luckily Dr Google has provided us with some info that this practice didn't, which has gone someway to calming my partners anxiety.

So due to the lack of 1-2-1 support, failure to explain what the results meant my in-laws my partners employers and I are picking up the slack for researching, informing and support.

Truly terrible health care  from an organisation that wants public
